name: Roughness
resampling: reproject to EPSG:32632, aggregate to 100 m with average (mean)

name: Road_Density
variable: gis_osm_roads_free_1: roads rasterised as presence/absence, then 5x5 uniform filter (500 m window mean)
period: extract date of the Geofabrik dumps
resampling: rasterised directly onto the 100 m template

name: PA_Distance
variable: Euclidean distance (m) to the nearest protected-area boundary, from the rasterised polygons
period: see note: markdown says May 2026, the code path says Jun2026
resampling: rasterised directly onto the 100 m template

name: SummerPrecip
variable: BIO18 = total precipitation of the warmest quarter (mm)
resampling: COG streamed via /vsicurl, bilinear to the 100 m template

name: WinterTemp
variable: BIO11 = mean temperature of the coldest quarter
resampling: COG streamed via /vsicurl, bilinear to the 100 m template
